scope: Packet dynamics, frozen controls, spectrum normalization, current cadence authority and additive complete-history resume guard. No new optimization, long dynamics, manuscript edit or extra physics acceptance condition.

science_findings.finding: The 56 box failed the unchanged duration predicate; the 80 box followed those diagnostics. Selection is coefficient-blind, and the accepted 57.4–64.2 window was frozen before controls. The whole process was not globally preregistered.
Both half-timestep and 96-box controls use the same frozen interval. Existing independent review recomputes all five predicates and all 35-row means; no new defect found.

Six motifs retain eight physical springs each, actual per-link g=(1,2,3,4,5,6)/7. Full-force/current one-step controls and exact y/z reduction were already independently checked; no axial symmetry is introduced.

Time-domain result is the two lower lattice-branch stored energy in a periodic Fourier embedding, divided by the physical initial open-line energy. It is not local flux, exact transversality for all k, an electromagnetic field, or the monochromatic stationary coefficient.
Use the explicitly open-normalized spectral field for direct comparison. The existing FROZEN_CONTROLS_CHECK.json already does so. Tail-only bounds do not bound quadrature or time-domain errors.

The corrected secondary endpoint-inclusive cadence fields and current analyzer supersede the old secondary fields in frozen main/half-step JSONs. Primary 0.2-grid means, dynamics and frozen window are unchanged.

reproducibility_findings.local_raw_size_check: PASS for all 58 manifested paths; this pass checks sizes, not a repeat hash of all 3.162 GB.
reproducibility_findings.finding: One complete continuation state is not a replacement for earlier time histories. Source/configuration/preparation regenerate the raw data; the download must state clearly that the multi-gigabyte histories are excluded. Small preserved H=2 fixtures are bundled separately for guard tests.

The frozen C++ engine appends histories without alignment guards. The additive safe_resume.py rejects stale/missing/truncated/misaligned histories, checks complete checkpoint/model binding and endpoint state, freshly compiles pinned source for execution, preserves prior configuration, updates completed targets, and records failures. The archived C++ remains unchanged.
An analyzer-ready final target at or after tau48 is required to align with the 0.2 snapshot grid. The additive guard enforces this, preserving the archived analyzer.

Recorded review receipts are immediately readable. Re-executing the modal reviewer requires regenerated raw files and its expected original run basename in a fresh workspace. The physical one-step reviewer needs fresh output directories.

Full replay is tested in Linux with Python, NumPy providing trapezoid (NumPy>=2), SciPy, and g++ with C++17/OpenMP. run_control.py uses the POSIX resource module. Native raw files are little-endian float64/int32. Cross-platform bitwise identity is not claimed.

additive_guard.scope: New one-step guard exercise only. Snapshot fixtures test file layout and are not asserted to be physical trajectories.
